verdict.rationale: Cognee is open source and runs fully on your own machine or stack, so your memory stays in infrastructure you control rather than a vendor silo. You can also wipe everything on exit with the forget 'full cleanup' operation. However, no documented export command or open-format dump (e.g. graph/vector export) appears; the RDF/OWL ontology support is input-only, and the only data-movement CLI shown is `push` to Cognee Cloud. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data (graph, vectors, raw data) in open formats, a Cloud-to-local export path, and independent confirmation that migrating off works.
